RANG.DESCRIPTION: Show the rank card with level, XP and position

XP.DESCRIPTION: Change a member's XP by hand (with a reason)
XP.KEIN_DASHBOARD: The dashboard did not answer, so nothing runs ({{grund}}).
XP.KEIN_RECHT: You lack the permission {{recht}}. It is granted in the dashboard under Permissions.
XP.SCHON_NULL: {{name}} has no XP, there is nothing to remove.
XP.NICHTS: {{name}} already has exactly this amount. Nothing changed.
XP.RESET_FRAGE:
{{name}} has {{xp}} XP (level {{level}}). This resets them to 0 XP; reward roles go too. The booking stays in the history and can be traced.

To confirm, click the button and type the username.
XP.RESET_FALSCH: The name does not match (expected: {{name}}). Nothing changed.
XP.ERG_GEKUERZT: There was less than requested; removed down to 0.
